summary: Russian ballistic missile strikes on Kyiv resulted in 9 deaths and 33 injuries, causing damage to residential and administrative buildings. In Moscow, an explosion at a restaurant reportedly killed 3 people and injured nearly 20. Concurrently, Russian forces have advanced near Kostiantynivka and Zalichne.
key_points: Russian ballistic missile strikes on Kyiv caused 9 deaths and 33 injuries, damaging residential buildings and administrative structures (Source: @UkraineNow/83098).
An explosion at a restaurant in central Moscow reportedly killed 3 people and injured nearly 20 (Source: @UkraineNow/83098).
Russian forces have advanced near Kostiantynivka and Zalichne (Source: @DeepStateUA/23714).
The Russian military has reportedly begun using a new type of drone with unknown characteristics (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32102).
Russia struck the Yanina container ship and infrastructure at three Russian refineries in Bashkortostan (Source: @UkraineNow/83098).
Russian assault groups from the 3rd Army Corps are reported to be in Druzhkivka (Source: @tass_agency/388279).
An FPV drone strike in Dnipropetrovsk region injured 7 people, including a 16-year-old (Source: @UkraineNow/83089).
President Zelensky stated only one ballistic missile was intercepted due to a lack of Patriot missiles (Source: @UkraineNow/83096).

points: A Russian attack on Kharkiv using two 'issile drones' destroyed a warehouse belonging to the 'Ranok' publishing house and the 'Knyh overland' bookstore network (Source: @UkraineNow/83092).
In Kyiv, ballistic strikes caused partial destruction of a 5-story building in Solomianskyi district and damage to administrative buildings in Darnytskyi district (Source: @UkraineNow/83068).
A man in Kharkiv was detained after attempting to shoot National Guard commander Igor Obolenko using an AI-generated photo as deception (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32091).
In Dnipropetrovsk, an FPV drone strike on a passenger minibus resulted in 7 injuries, including two in serious condition (Source: @UkraineNow/83089).
The 'Knyh overland' bookstore network has suspended online orders following the destruction of its distribution center (Source: @UkraineNow/83092).
An explosion at a restaurant in central Moscow, possibly during a general's birthday celebration, killed 3 and injured nearly 20 (Source: @UkraineNow/83098).
Russian infrastructure at three refineries in Bashkortostan was targeted and hit (Source: @UkraineNow/83098).
The Russian container ship Yanina was struck (Source: @UkraineNow/83098).
Russian forces are conducting operations in Kostiantynivka and Zalichne (Source: @DeepStateUA/23714).
Russian assault groups from the 3rd Army Corps are operating in Druzhkivka (Source: @tass_agency/388279).
Russian forces have made advances near Kostiantynivka and Zalichne (Source: @DeepStateUA/23714).
Russian assault groups from the 3rd Army Corps are reported to be in Druzhkivka (Source: @tass_agency/388279).
Russian forces are conducting clearing operations in Krasny Lyman (Source: @tass_agency/388264).
UAVs were reported in the Sumy region heading north (Source: @kpszsu/71140).
UAVs were reported in the Chernihiv region heading towards the reservoir and Kulikivka (Source: @eRadarrua/103728).
UAVs were reported in the Chernihiv region heading towards Kyiv/Brovary (Source: @kpszsu/71145).
UAVs were reported in the Kherson region heading towards Mykolaiv (Source: @kpszsu/71140).
UAVs were reported in the Kherson region heading towards the Black Sea near Zatoka (Source: @eRadarrua/103723).
UAVs were reported in the Mykolaiv region heading towards Berdznehuvate (Source: @kpszsu/71153).
Russia is capable of conducting three to four large-scale attacks per month, launching up to 70-80 missiles and several hundred drones (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32106).
President Zelensky reported that only one ballistic missile was intercepted due to a lack of Patriot interceptor missiles (Source: @UkraineNow/83096).
UAV experts claim the Russian military has begun using a new type of drone with unknown characteristics (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32102).

sections.threat_assessment: The threat level is high due to sustained Russian ballistic missile strikes on urban centers like Kyiv, causing significant casualties. The use of new, unidentified drone types by Russian forces introduces additional tactical uncertainty. Continued targeting of civilian infrastructure and logistics hubs remains a primary Russian operational objective.
sections.regional_response: The Ukrainian government is calling for increased anti-ballistic missile capabilities, specifically Patriot systems, to mitigate civilian casualties. There is ongoing political tension regarding US aid and the potential for peace negotiations involving 'ed lines' for both sides. International diplomatic efforts are noted as being in a state of flux.
sections.intelligence_notes: The use of AI-generated imagery for disinformation was observed in an attempt to target a National Guard commander in Kharkiv. Russian military units, specifically the 3rd Army Corps, are actively engaging in the Donetsk direction. The deployment of new UAV technologies by Russia requires immediate technical assessment.
